# mailtrap_contact_field (Resource)

Manages a custom contact field that can be set on Mailtrap contacts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailtrap_contact_field" "example" {
  name      = "Subscription Plan"
  data_type = "text"
  merge_tag = "subscription_plan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_type` (String) Value type of the field. Changing this forces replacement.
- `merge_tag` (String) Merge tag used to personalize campaigns with the field's per-contact value.
- `name` (String) Name of the contact field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the contact field.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a contact field by its numeric ID.
terraform import mailtrap_contact_field.example 12345
```
